name: Paranormal Cryptid Lovers
source:
In Paranormal Cryptid Lovers, you're an aspiring filmmaker with a passion for monster movies. Ready to head to film school, your summer plans change when you're forced to spend time in Everly Springs—your eccentric Uncle Gary's hometown. Working at his retro video store, you uncover paranormal secrets, cryptid myths, and a summer love that you never saw coming.

From cryptid legends to supernatural beings, Everly Springs is hiding more than just a few mysteries. Dive into a 90s-era small-town where ghosts, cryptids, and paranormal ikemen await. Can you capture them on film or will they capture your heart?

Will you fall for the clairvoyant, swamp man, ghost, or the mysterious Owlman?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.buffyotome]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
在《超自然隐秘恋人》中，你是一位对怪物电影充满热情、有抱负的电影制作人。准备好前往电影学校后，你的暑期计划发生了变化，因为你被迫去艾弗利泉——你古怪的加里叔叔的家乡。在他的复古音像店工作时，你会发现超自然的秘密、神秘的神话，以及你从未预见到的夏日爱情。

从神秘的传说到超自然的生物，埃弗利泉隐藏的不仅仅是一些谜团。潜入一座90年代的小镇，那里有鬼魂、神秘生物和超自然现象等待着你。你能在电影中捕捉到它们吗？它们会俘获你的心吗？

你会爱上千里眼、沼泽人、幽灵，还是神秘的猫头鹰人？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.buffyotome]Google Play[/url]]
